ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels localized on the lateral lobe surfaces versus 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the median region and along the trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions on both the left and right lobes; a black central wedge originating from the peduncle; a distinct small circular black spot located on the mid-lateral left lobe; multiple small dark punctate spots scattered across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to the vertical axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central trailing edge, transitioning to higher amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; leading edges are largely obscured by the camera angle and water surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of raised, high-contrast white and grey circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips and along the trailing edge of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least four thin, dark, parallel-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the ventral-right lobe, angled approximately 45 degrees toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization and associated tissue scarring on the distal margins of both lobes; a possible small indentation or notch on the right trailing edge near the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, solitary circular dark ring/ocellus located in the lower-central region of the white left-lobe pigmentation.
